programs.title: Chopped
programs.desc: Four winners return to compete for the jackpot and the title of grand champion! The chefs have a choice to gamble away an ingredient before each round, and the $25,000 jackpot will get higher or lower depending on the champs' good or bad fortune.

programs.title: Chopped Castaways
programs.desc: Twelve chefs are split into teams on a remote island and must create three-course meals with no electricity; in round one, a venomous threat in the basket tests their nerve; the lowest-performing chefs are sent to the Gauntlet for a head-to-head battle.

programs.title: 24 in 24: Last Chef Standing
programs.desc: Fatigue sets in as the chefs face hours seven and eight in this intense culinary journey; Michael Symon and Esther Choi put forth three challenges, in which the chefs must turn one bag of ingredients into three distinct meals for judge Scott Conant.
